email.subject: CSEC Invitation
email.body:
Greetings #PLAYERNAME#,
The CSEC group is an invite-only group of talented hackers and digital security experts. We offer substantial knowledge and resources to exceptional individuals to create a community of shared learning, information and progress. A member of our group has extended an invitation for you to join our organization.
As an administrative detail, we'll require a small demonstration of your abilities and knowledge in order for you to be accepted into the group.
To continue, please reply to this email with the password you will find associated with your name on one of our test servers. If you have any difficulties, we recommend you consult the Network Education Archives.
Congratulations, and good luck. -CSEC Administration
